name: Dreamdata
description:
Dreamdata is an Agentic B2B Attribution Platform that gives marketing teams the most complete view of their customer journey anywhere - so they can answer any question about marketing's impact and know where to invest next. Dreamdata unifies all your GTM data into one account-based data model, including the anonymous visits and ad impressions your CRM never sees, organized by account and tied to revenue.



We're a team that cares deeply about helping marketers do their best work and are always looking for great people to join us.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description:
About Dreamdata

Dreamdata is the industry leader in B2B marketing attribution and activation. We're on a mission to help B2B marketing leaders finally connect their efforts directly to real revenue - solving a complex problem that has plagued the industry for years.

It's working. We have achieved strong product-market fit and are experiencing explosive, triple-digit YoY growth. This momentum is now backed by a recent $55,000,000 Series B funding round set to fuel our rocketship as we scale globally.

We’re now building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help multiply our impact, and deliver the value of Dreamdata faster than ever.  

The Opportunity

We’re looking for builders. You’ll become an expert in the Dreamdata platform and work with our prospects and customers to deploy a best-in-class go-to-market engine tailored to their specific needs. The FDE plays a critical role in bringing our customers from nascent GTM reporting and attribution, to the industry leading standard that Dreamdata sets. 

You’ll lead technical discovery to gather customer requirements, implement a best-in-class Dreamdata setup, and resolve technical blockers in the onboarding process. Internally, you’ll identify usage patterns and gaps to help our product team develop the Dreamdata of the future!

This is a hands-on-keyboard role with significant customer-facing responsibility. If you are a tenacious project manager, are comfortable working cross-functionally both internally and with customers, and thrive in the whitespace, this is the role for you. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Own customer onboarding: Lead new customers through a structured onboarding of the Dreamdata Platform, from requirements gathering to a best-in-class Dreamdata setup. 
  • Gather requirements and secure data access: Run kickoff and discovery sessions to understand each new customer’s go-to-market motion, reporting goals, and tech stack, then coordinate access to the CRM, marketing tools, and data sources the implementation depends on.
  • Validate data and enable customers: Check data quality and attribution outputs against the customer’s expectations, fix setup issues before handoff, and train customer teams on the reports and workflows they need to get value quickly.
  • Run Build with Dreamdata Clinics: Becoming a thought leader among our customers and use your expertise to customize the Dreamdata platform via Dreamdata's Agent, MCP Server or Data Warehouse based on customer needs.
  • Improve the onboarding playbook: Document and automate repeatable processes, templates, and best practices, and share customer feedback and recurring technical issues with Product, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to constantly improve on the customer experience.

Requirements

Must-have

  • Customer-facing experience: 2–4 years in a customer-facing role, such as implementation, onboarding, solutions consulting, customer success, or technical account management.
  • Hands-on experience with the modern go-to-market stack, including:
    • Ad platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Google, Meta)
    • Web tagging infrastructure (e.g., Google Tag Manager)
    • CRMs (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics)
    • Marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Clay)
  • Technical curiosity: You can develop a deep understanding of Dreamdata’s data model and connect it to our customers' business needs. 
  • Fluency in marketing analytics: You understand how B2B attribution works, why it matters to revenue teams, and where it gets complicated.
  • Practical AI experience: You’ve built automations or workflows with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, not just used them to answer questions.
  • Clear communication with any audience: You can explain Dreamdata’s integrations to an engineer in technical detail and to an executive in business terms.

Nice-to-have

  • Cloud platform experience or certifications, ideally Google Cloud
  • Experience with server-side tracking and/or REST APIs
  • A project management certification, such as PMP or CAPM
  • Change management experience: you’ve guided customers through new ways of working or technology adoption programs. 
  • SQL experience 

Location

  • Copenhagen, Denmark
  • Some travel to our NYC office should be expected

Benefits

  • Location: Our office is located in the heart of Copenhagen with a harbor view
  • Ownership: Equity in a growing company.
  • Lunch: Delicious lunch available in our canteen
  • Inclusive Culture: Be part of a supportive and dynamic team making an impact in the B2B marketing space
  • Private insurance: Private health insurance that comes with our pension plan
  • Office dogs

At Dreamdata, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. Join us in shaping the future of B2B marketing analytics and activation while developing your skills and growing your career.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. If you’re passionate about building meaningful connections and helping businesses succeed, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: RevOps Manager
jobs.description:
About Dreamdata

Dreamdata is the industry leader in B2B marketing attribution and activation. We're on a mission to help B2B marketing leaders finally connect their efforts directly to real revenue - solving a complex problem that has plagued the industry for years.

It's working. We have achieved strong product-market fit and are experiencing explosive, triple-digit YoY growth. This momentum is now backed by a recent $55,000,000 Series B funding round set to fuel our rocketship as we scale globally.

We’re now scaling our GTM engine and are looking for a hands-on RevOps Manager to help us build reliable, scalable revenue systems across Sales, Marketing, SDR, and Customer Success functions.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on Revenue Operations role with a strong technical focus on systems architecture, automation, and integrations. The role requires ownership of core GTM systems and building scalable workflows across the stack. If you are motivated by leveraging AI to design, integrate, and extend internal tools, this is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of our internal platform and data infrastructure.

You'll report directly to the COO, with day-to-day priorities and operational guidance coming from the Senior Revenue Operations Manager. You'll partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure our GTM systems are clean, automated, and dependable as the company scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own HubSpot administration including objects, properties, lifecycle stages, workflows, permissions, and routing logic
  • Design, build, and maintain Zapier/n8n automations, including multi-step workflows, error handling, and monitoring
  • Work with routing and round-robin logic based on segment, geography, and SLA requirements
  • Support SDR outbound workflows through system design and automation
  • Maintain data hygiene across GTM systems (deduplication, enrichment, validation)
  • Own and monitor integrations across GTM tools, ensuring sync reliability and fast issue resolution
  • Partner closely with RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and CS to translate GTM needs into scalable system solutions

Requirements

Must-Have  

  • Design, build, and continuously optimize GTM processes through automated workflows, reducing manual work across Sales, Marketing, SDR, and Customer Success
  • Hands-on experience as a HubSpot Admin (workflows, objects, lifecycle, routing)
  • Strong experience with Zapier or similar products, including complex, multi-step automations
  • Experience building and maintaining web forms and demo request flows
  • Solid understanding of lead routing, round-robin logic, and GTM handoffs
  • Comfortable working closely with commercial stakeholders
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and excited about owning systems end-to-end
  • Experience with SQL or a similar querying language to extract and analyze data across our systems

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting SDR tooling (e.g. Outreach, Orum)
  • Familiarity with enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha)
  • Experience with reverse ETL tools (Hightouch)
  • Exposure to product or web analytics tools (Segment)
  • Experience with BigQuery and Looker
  • Exposure to software development processes
  • Exposure to finance operations

Location

  • New York, NY
  • Some travel to our Copenhagen office should be expected

Benefits

At Dreamdata, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. Join us in shaping the future of B2B marketing analytics and activation while developing your skills and growing your career.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. If you’re passionate about building meaningful connections and helping businesses succeed, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Total Compensation: ~$145k for the right candidate
  • Health/Dental/Vision Insurance 100% Covered
  • 401(k)
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Office dogs

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative EMEA
jobs.description:
About Dreamdata

Dreamdata is the industry leader in B2B marketing attribution and activation. We're on a mission to help B2B marketing leaders finally connect their efforts directly to real revenue - solving a complex problem that has plagued the industry for years.

Founded in 2018 by ex-Trustpilot (TRST:LSE) product and engineering leaders, Dreamdata was born from a real-world need, building the platform they always wished they'd had. 

It's working. We have achieved strong product-market fit and are experiencing explosive, triple-digit YoY growth. This momentum is now backed by a recent $55,000,000 Series B funding round set to fuel our rocketship as we scale globally.

We are expanding rapidly and looking for exceptional, top-tier talent to help us build the future of B2B marketing.

The Opportunity

As an SDR at Dreamdata, you will connect with businesses that can benefit from our platform but have not yet discovered it. You will work closely with our sales and marketing teams to engage prospects, create interest, and build a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities.

The SDR role is evolving, and you will be empowered by cutting-edge technology designed to amplify your workflows and impact. Our dedicated Go-to-Market Engineering team is at the forefront of implementing the newest innovations, including GenAI and AI Agents, to streamline processes, enhance outreach effectiveness, and provide you with intelligent tools to excel in your role.

This role is an excellent opportunity for someone eager to grow a career in sales. We are committed to your development, with a structured path to becoming an Account Executive within 18–24 months. You will be part of our hybrid Copenhagen office, working alongside a collaborative and supportive team.

Key Responsibilities

Build relationships with potential customers through multiple channels: LinkedIn, email, phone, and community engagement.

  • Become an expert in marketing analytics, the B2B customer journey, and the Dreamdata platform.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to develop, test, and refine messaging and outreach strategies.
  • Support the marketing team in demand generation and outbound initiatives.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality, sales-qualified opportunities to our Account Executives.
  • Be at the forefront of an emerging, data-driven go-to-market function for B2B companies.

Requirements

  • Strong communicator, both written and verbal.
  • Organized and confident managing time, priorities, and a high volume of activity.
  • Motivated by growth opportunities and excited to work in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Adaptable, curious, and eager to learn new tools, markets, and approaches.
  • Tenacious and proactive in building relationships and following up with prospects.
  • Build relationships with potential customers through multiple channels: LinkedIn, email, phone, and community engagement.

Benefits

  • Location: Our office is located in the heart of Copenhagen with a harbor view
  • Ownership: Equity in a growing company.
  • Lunch: Delicious lunch available in our canteen
  • Inclusive Culture: Be part of a supportive and dynamic team making an impact in the B2B marketing space
  • Private insurance: Private health insurance that comes with our pension plan
  • Office dogs 

At Dreamdata, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact. Join us in shaping the future of B2B marketing analytics and activation while developing your skills and growing your career.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. If you’re passionate about building meaningful connections and helping businesses succeed, we’d love to hear from you.
